purpose: Slicer extension for CT temporal bone scans. It guides fiducial and Elastix rigid registration against an atlas, ROI cropping, and deep-learning segmentation (via the ABLInfer package, run in local Docker or on a remote server). It also exports results for CardinalSim and includes a batch registration module.
summary: The extension is BSD-3 licensed, the catalog entry's build dependencies match CMake, and the atlas download is checksummed. Three problems stand out. First, the module runs pip_install("ablinfer") at import time, unpinned and without asking. Second, the build downloads Resources/Models/ABLTempSeg.json from a mutable master branch into the source tree, and the committed file is only a placeholder. Third, the remote-inference path disables TLS verification, stores the password in plain text in the settings, and uploads volumes with no explicit data-transfer notice. There are also soundness bugs, such as an unimported logging module and Elastix instantiated at class-definition time. I could not inspect ablinfer itself.
